scope: Preregistered independent four-method confirmation; all outcomes retained. Ours/V2E/init-only use target GT only for offline scoring. The separately reported state_reference runs the original policy with original noisy-GT observations as a feasibility reference. Primary all_precontact_state metrics retain every available precontact state; separately named precontact metrics exclude grasp propagation.
